home.foldableDesc: Our building systems require no permanent foundation — they can be transported and reassembled on a new site: fast installation, low cost, maximum flexibility.
home.foldableF1Body: No concrete foundation required. Ready for installation in 1–3 days.
home.foldableF2Body: Disassemble and relocate to a different site whenever needed.
home.foldableF3Body: Up to 40% savings compared to conventional construction.
home.processStep01Desc: Site survey, needs analysis and preparation of a client-specific technical project file.
home.processStep02Desc: ISO-standard, quality-controlled production of steel structural components.
home.processStep03Desc: Packaging and safe, planned delivery of all components to the construction site.
home.processStep04Desc: Fast, safe and technically supervised installation on site by our expert team.
home.processStep05Desc: Final inspections, client acceptance and turnkey handover with warranty certificate.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Prefabricated buildings, light steel systems, container solutions and more.

prefabrik-yapilar.description: Modular building systems manufactured in the factory and assembled on site, delivering fast installation and competitive pricing. Ready solutions for residential, office, site facility and social infrastructure projects.

subcategoryDescriptions.tek-katli: Single-storey prefabricated buildings offering fast installation and cost-effective pricing.
subcategoryDescriptions.iki-katli: Two-storey prefabricated buildings providing larger living and working areas.
subcategoryDescriptions.villa-tipi: Aesthetic and comfortable villa-type prefabricated residential solutions.
subcategoryDescriptions.santiye-yapilari: Durable and portable site offices and accommodation structures.
subcategoryDescriptions.ofis-ve-idari: Construction of modern office and administrative buildings with prefabricated steel structural systems.
subcategoryDescriptions.sosyal-tesisler: Prefabricated social facility buildings such as cafeterias, gymnasiums and community spaces.
subcategoryDescriptions.egitim-ve-saglik: Rapidly procurable prefabricated structures for schools, clinics and health centres.

features: Factory production and on-site assembly reduces construction time significantly
Steel structural system provides high seismic resistance
Standard modular dimensions enable fast delivery
Doors, windows and insulation systems are factory-integrated
Low long-term maintenance costs and extended service life

hafif-celik-yapilar.description: Earthquake-resistant and energy-efficient buildings manufactured with galvanised steel profile systems. A broad solution range from homes to villas, from tiny houses to modular housing systems.

subcategoryDescriptions.hafif-celik-evler: Earthquake-resistant modern homes manufactured with a light steel structural system.
subcategoryDescriptions.villa-projeleri: Custom villa projects realised with the light steel system.
subcategoryDescriptions.tiny-house: Light steel tiny house structures offering maximum comfort in minimal spaces.
subcategoryDescriptions.moduler-konut-sistemleri: Modular light steel housing systems manufactured in the factory and assembled on site.
subcategoryDescriptions.katlanir-tasinabilir: Light steel structures requiring no permanent foundation — easily transported and reassembled.

features: 30–50% lighter than heavy concrete structures
Corrosion and moisture resistance through galvanised steel profiles
Fast installation with minimal ground preparation time
Class A energy efficiency with sandwich panel integration
Portable or relocatable building option available

konteyner-sistemleri.description: ISO-standard, turnkey-equipped container building solutions suitable for modular combination. Rapid delivery for residential, office, site and custom design projects.

subcategoryDescriptions.yasam-konteyneri: Container systems providing comfortable living spaces at high insulation standards.
subcategoryDescriptions.ofis-konteyneri: Container solutions serving site and office needs with fast installation advantages.
subcategoryDescriptions.santiye-konteyneri: Durable and secure container structures for site operations.
subcategoryDescriptions.tiny-house-konteyner: Container tiny house solutions designed around a minimal living philosophy.
subcategoryDescriptions.katlanir-konteyner: Foldable container systems easy to transport and store, opening quickly when needed.
subcategoryDescriptions.ozel-tasarim: Container structures manufactured to custom dimensions and configurations.

features: High-strength steel body manufactured to ISO standards
Factory-complete turnkey delivery (electrical, plumbing)
Modular combination allows complexes of different sizes
Portable solution with transport and reinstallation support
Double-skin sandwich panel option for thermal and acoustic insulation

endustriyel-celik-yapilar.description: Wide-span, column-free steel systems for factory, warehouse, hangar and agricultural building needs. Industrial reliability with high load capacity and long service life.

subcategoryDescriptions.celik-hangarlar: Wide-span industrial steel hangars with high load-bearing capacity.
subcategoryDescriptions.fabrika-binalari: Customisable steel factory building solutions adapted to production lines.
subcategoryDescriptions.depolar: Large-volume steel warehouse structures for logistics and storage operations.
subcategoryDescriptions.hayvan-barinalari: Ventilated and durable steel shelter structures for livestock operations.
subcategoryDescriptions.tarimsal-yapilar: Steel building solutions for agricultural activities such as greenhouses, barns and farm stores.

features: Wide-span, column-free interior design
Calculated structure against high snow and wind loads
Steel components protected long-term with shot-blasting and paint
Steel frame compatible with crane rail systems and mezzanine integration
Fast assembly minimises production downtime

yapisal-bilesenler.description: CNC plasma-cut and custom-manufactured steel profiles, chassis, roof and cladding systems. TSE and EN standard-compliant load-bearing solutions with rapid delivery from project to handover.

subcategoryDescriptions.celik-profiller: Precision-manufactured standard and custom steel profiles for load-bearing systems.
subcategoryDescriptions.sasi-sistemleri: Strong steel chassis systems for containers and modular structures.
subcategoryDescriptions.cati-ve-celik-sac: Long-lasting, waterproof roof cladding and steel sheet products.
subcategoryDescriptions.panel-ve-kaplama: Thermally insulated sandwich panels and façade cladding systems.
subcategoryDescriptions.ozel-uretim: CNC-machined and custom-manufactured steel components to project specifications.

features: Certified steel profiles compliant with TSE and EN standards
Precision tolerances with CNC plasma cutting and laser machining
Custom cross-section and length options per project
Surface protection alternatives with galvanising or epoxy paint
Stock management and logistics support for fast delivery

corporate.ctaTitle: Would You Like to Work With Us?
corporate.ctaDesc: Write to us on WhatsApp to discuss your project.
corporate.about1: At TV Çelik A.Ş., with over 30 years of experience, we are proud to be one of the sector's trusted solution partners in the production of prefabricated buildings, container systems, light steel structures, hangars and animal shelters.
corporate.about2: From production to assembly, from dismantling to reassembly and turnkey projects, we meticulously manage every process — creating safe, sustainable living and working spaces for millions of people.
corporate.about3: With our approach sensitive to the environment, living beings and people, we continue to produce durable, functional and modern structures, redefining the concept of living space.
corporate.mission: To produce high-quality, durable and rapidly deployable light steel, prefabricated and modular building solutions, providing our clients with safe, economical and long-lasting residential and working spaces.
corporate.vision: To become a trusted, strong and preferred brand in Turkey and globally through an innovative manufacturing approach in light steel and modular building systems.
